name: Concord
type: city in the United States; state or insular area capital of the United States; county seat
text: Concord () is the capital city of the U.S. state of New Hampshire and the seat of Merrimack County. As of the 2020 United States census the population was 43,976, making it the 3rd most populous city in New Hampshire after Manchester and Nashua. The area was first settled by Europeans in 1659.

depictions.name: Concord
depictions.text: Concord, Massachusetts Concord is a town in the Frontier located near Boston, Massachusetts. James Barrett served as the colonel of the town's militia during the American Revolutionary War.
